findings.trigger: Any call to page(items, offset, limit) with limit >= 1, e.g. page([1,2,3,4], 0, 4).
findings.impact: The slice end is offset + limit - 1, so the function returns limit - 1 records instead of limit, contradicting its docstring ('Return up to limit records beginning at offset'). Every page silently drops the last record it should contain; a client walking the new cursor-based listing endpoint page by page will permanently skip one record per page (e.g. the 4th, 8th, ... record for limit=4) with no error raised. The correct expression is items[offset:offset + limit], as in the base commit.
